### How do I tell if my Cali Clear is real or fake?

Scan the QR code on the packaging. Real Cali Clear products link to a verification page showing lab results, batch number, and authenticity confirmation. Fakes either have no QR code, broken codes, or codes leading to unrelated pages. Other signs include misspelled text, poor print quality, and unusually dark oil color.

### Why is my Cali Clear not hitting?

The three most common causes are: (1) a clogged mouthpiece — warm the device gently and take short soft puffs, (2) low battery — most Cali Clear devices need to be charged out of the box, (3) air-activation issue — inhale slowly without pressing any button. If none of these fixes work, see our complete troubleshooting guide.

### Won’t Charge or Stopped Working?

Check the charging port for debris and ensure your USB-C cable is fully inserted. If the LED doesn’t light when plugged in, try a different cable or charging brick before assuming the device is dead.

### Clogged or Hard to Pull?

A clogged Cali Clear usually means oil has settled in the mouthpiece. Warm the device gently in your hands for 30 seconds, then take a few short, soft puffs to clear the airway. Don’t force hard pulls.
